data.narrative:
Diode is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Davide Asnaghi and Lenny Khazan, having raised $10M+ to date. The valuation universe includes 8 private peers in robotics and manufacturing (Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Bedrock Robotics among them) and 1 public comparable.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using total capital raised ($10M) as a proxy for seed valuation, a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $25M. This multiplier reflects typical seed-to-Series A progression in the sector. The peer-median method could not be applied due to insufficient comparable datapoints—while 8 same-sector peers exist in the dataset, fewer than 3 peers matched narrow filters (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier), making a median-based approach unreliable.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $21M (low) to $29M (high), with a median of $25M. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for Diode's specific market position and execution risk, the limited peer set for validation, and the absence of comparable transaction data at this stage. A subsequent analysis incorporating Series A-stage comparables or customer/revenue metrics, if available, would materially strengthen conviction in this range.
